title: Campaign manifest
description: The campaign.json file at the root of a Quire campaign repository. Only $schemaVersion and name are required; everything else is a hint.

$schemaVersion.description: SemVer of the Quire schema this campaign was authored against.

license.description: SPDX identifier for the campaign content license. Defaults to CC-BY-SA-4.0.

ip.description: Free-text statement of IP / copyright attribution. E.g. 'Original world by <name>; mechanics adapted from Quire v0.1'.

contentNotes.description: List of content topics that prospective players should be aware of (violence, drugs, intimacy, etc.). Not a content warning system; an honesty signal.

defaultAiProvider.description: Hint to the runtime about which AI provider the campaign expects. Players may override.

signaling.description: Optional override of the default signaling broker.

turn.description: Optional TURN server override. v0.1 ships STUN-only; this is reserved for future use.

ruleset.description: Identifier for the ruleset this campaign uses. Defaults to 'quire-v0.1' which is the bundled reference ruleset.

homepage.description: Optional URL for the campaign's homepage or extended documentation.

episodes.description: Optional list of episode slug directory names (under episodes/). The runtime renders these in the order given as the campaign's navigation menu. Slugs that match this regex are accepted: [A-Za-z0-9._-]+.
